title: Honesty Testing of LLMs and AI Agents: A Vision for Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2610.34239v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Human oversight of large language models (LLMs) and artificial intelligence (AI) agents increasingly depends on their reports. Claims that conflict with a system's own judgments can conceal failures, prevent timely intervention, and contribute to severe harm. Greater autonomy makes faithful reporting increasingly important for maintaining human control. In this vision paper, we propose honesty testing of LLMs and AI agents as a new research area in software engineering. Building on existing honesty evaluations, our goal is to make faithful reporting a software quality requirement that developers can specify, test, and maintain. We define honesty bugs as behavioural defects in which an LLM or AI agent, when required to communicate faithfully, makes an explicit claim that conflicts with its own judgment at the time of reporting. translated_title: 大语言模型与AI智能体的诚实性测试：软件工程的愿景
translated_abstract: 对大语言模型（LLM）和人工智能（AI）智能体的人类监督日益依赖于它们的报告。与系统自身判断相冲突的陈述可能掩盖失败、妨碍及时干预，并导致严重危害。随着智能体自主性不断增强，忠实报告对于维持人类控制变得愈发重要。在这篇愿景论文中，我们提出将LLM和AI智能体的诚实性测试作为软件工程的一个新研究领域。在现有诚实性评估的基础上，我们的目标是使忠实报告成为开发者可以规定、测试和维护的软件质量需求。我们将诚实性缺陷定义为一种行为缺陷：当LLM或AI智能体被要求忠实沟通时，作出了与其报告时刻自身判断相冲突的明确陈述。我们提出了一个初步框架，涵盖受控输入下的LLM级测试和智能体级测试。
tldr: 这篇愿景论文提出将LLM和AI智能体的诚实性测试作为软件工程的新研究领域，把忠实报告确立为可规定、可测试、可维护的软件质量需求，并定义了“诚实性缺陷”概念及初步测试框架。
en_tdlr: This vision paper proposes honesty testing of LLMs and AI agents as a new software engineering research area, establishing faithful reporting as a specifiable, testable, and maintainable software quality requirement, and defining honesty bugs with an initial testing framework.
